scope.purpose: A bounded synthetic site inventory, backup-backed fault/restore exercise, and per-resource migration ledger using canonical core resources and transport sites.
siteState: observed power, reachability, administration, backup, and restore availability
canonicalReferences: Each transportSite reference must resolve to a canonical current transport site and agree with its reported region and domains.
Administrative, endpoint, backup, and restore references must resolve to canonical current core resources.
Bindings carry both site and resource generation. Reconfiguration invalidates stale bindings and exercise evidence.
operationalDependencies: Customer/provider ownership and each administrative action use an independent trusted authorization hook.
Backup and restore resources are separate canonical resources; an accepted restore receipt is required.
Fault injection and clearing must change actual parent-observed failure state; a local exercise status toggle is insufficient.
A baseline journey is recorded before fault injection; outage and recovery journeys target the actual surviving canonical endpoint and include interaction and physical edge references.
Restore is asynchronous: captured resource configs must become effective again before a fresh recovered journey completes the exercise.
Shared-risk labels must be returned by the canonical transport-site resolver.

goals.progress.goal.ln: At least two effective sites and an evidenced cross-site baseline, survivor-targeted fault interval journeys, and a fresh journey after recovery.
goals.progress.goal.df: A completed backup-backed restore at a site whose captured effective ownership is local and controlled and whose administration, backup, and restore resources were observed available at completion.
goals.progress.goal.m2: For the same two-site pair, completed power and whole-site failures targeted at each site plus a shared-risk test; each exercise requires faulted and recovered survivor journeys and verified restore.

scope.migration: A migration snapshots source and target site generations. Each resource has an independent accepted transfer receipt. Partial items can retry without replaying accepted items; either site generation change blocks stale continuation.
limits: The site pack is optional and the central SOC dispatcher provides a synthetic adapter for its transport, resource, journey, and restore hooks; standalone or integration fixtures do not certify an external service.
Backup and restore receipts describe simulated in-game state transitions and are not external backup certification.
This does not reproduce the upstream SP geography, facility/equipment inventory, optical capacity model, construction market, or source reward economy.
The three source goal representations are bounded gameplay candidates; they do not establish full source conversion or external delivery.
